prompt_en: Make a deadpan barrack satire as a single carefully observed environmental photograph: the portrait-referenced person is caught in an ordinary duty interrupted in plain sight. Use the supplied portrait for visible facial and hair appearance: a soft oval face, large brown eyes, a small straight nose and softly parted rose lips; a dark chin-length bob with wispy separated fringe. The person's restrained, attentive presence and the soft daylight on the cheek lend a quiet human attraction to the institutional absurdity. In a long military barrack passage, a row of fresh wet boot prints crosses a newly polished floor from the open entrance. The person stands just inside the doorway in a plain olive work shirt, sleeves rolled, loose work trousers and practical boots. Their right hand holds the upright wooden mop handle at waist height; the mop head rests flat on the clean floor beside their right boot. Their left hand hangs relaxed. The person has stopped midway through cleaning, shoulders square to the camera and head turned a little toward the muddy trail, one eyebrow lifted in an incredulous response. At the far side of the threshold a newly arrived figure is visible from the knees down, one mud-dark boot planted at the first wet print and the other still on the exterior step. Both boot soles connect naturally with their surfaces. The trail leads from those boots into the shining corridor, so the cleaning tool, clean reflection and renewed dirt form one readable cause and consequence. The doorway is a clear rectangular division between wet exterior concrete and the meticulously cared-for interior. Repeated simple doors and aligned shoe shelves recede into depth, subordinated to the person and the broken clean-floor boundary. Photograph from inside the corridor at chest height with a modest wide lens, a full-length composition with a visible margin above the person's head and floor below both shoe soles, showing the person's face, both planted feet, mop contact and threshold together. Soft overcast daylight enters from the open door, reflected on the smooth floor; muted olive, cream and gray retain material wear. Hold enough depth of field for the arrival's boots and continuous print trail to remain legible, with natural skin texture and convincing joined hands, limbs and load-bearing feet. Place the cleaner in the left-middle foreground and the arrival's lower legs at the doorway on the right, keeping the continuous print trail and the complete hand-to-handle-to-mop-head path unobstructed across the lower frame. Soft local darkening sits immediately under the planted soles, while the connected lower legs and the floor surface remain visible.
